title: Image of the invisible God vs earthly image
english: Christ is [[the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation >> Bible:Colossians 1:15]]. Leave the world wearing only the [[image of the man of dust >> Bible:1 Corinthians 15:49]] and you are nothing in God’s city — bear the heavenly image.

True OET: no ANF; do not copy Trigg FOTC / Prinzivalli SC / Perrone 2015.

title: Pilgrim and sojourner — SERIES Amen
english: [[I am a sojourner with you, a pilgrim like all my fathers >> Bible:Psalm 39:12]]. [[Look away from me, that I may smile again before I depart >> Bible:Psalm 39:13]]. Glory to Christ Jesus forever. Amen.
